# Live verification report: scenario or session

- Report ID:
- Date/time and time zone:
- Operator/custodian:
- Module/adapter/version:
- Requirements/acceptance IDs:
- Scenario IDs:
- Platform and relevant product versions:
- Account/profile: opaque alias only
- Result: Passed | Failed | Blocked | Not Run

## Preconditions

List consent, expected non-destructive behavior, target service/process, authentication state category, and required credit/access. Do not record credentials or identifiable account details.

## Procedure

List the exact safe steps or approved command identifiers. Mark owner-only login/MFA/OTP steps as owner-performed; never transcribe their values.

## Expected result

Define observable, measurable pass criteria before execution.

## Observed result

Summarize behavior, timing, status classifications, and relevant sanitized identifiers. Do not paste raw provider responses, prompts/responses, source, environments, tokens, or paths that reveal account identity.

## Evidence custody

State evidence type, sanitized reference, storage/custodian, retention, and access. Record why any evidence cannot be committed.

## Side-effect check

Confirm default provider profiles, running agents, credentials, provider configuration, and unrelated files were not modified. Document any unexpected effect as an incident.

## Deviations and defects

List deviation/defect IDs, severity, owner, reproduction safety, and disposition.

## Conclusion

Explain why the result is Passed/Failed/Blocked/Not Run. A partial or unavailable run is never Passed.

## Sign-off

Operator and reviewer names/roles, dates, and any conditions.
